## What is this feature for?

Trips turn documented places into a travel program without duplicating their records.

## Before you start

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Where can I find it?** | Trips |
| **Access** | Map owner, Editor |

## Where can I find it?

Follow this path in the interface : **Trips**.

![Create and organize a trip](/docs/screenshots/trip-france-fr-mobile.png)

## How do I use it?

1. Create or select a trip.
2. Set departure, arrival, dates and days.
3. Add stops, nights and durations, then save.

### Expected result

A stop can reference a POI or a free location.

## How does it work?

- A stop can reference a POI or a free location.
- An occurrence duration may differ from the place record.
- On mobile, dialogs replace drag-and-drop for selecting and moving items.

## Good to know

:::note
- Changing dates may automatically add or remove days and nights.
:::
